execution: Authored routing/reasoning rubric, not an agent evaluation run. Runnable example coverage is documented separately in examples/README.md.

cases.input: A community-events page and sidebar use one adapter. The page wants accessible events first; the sidebar must retain default ordering. The service accepts prioritizeAccessible but selects only one event before returning.
required: Trace both actual callers through the adapter to service selection.
Forward the option for the page and preserve omission/default for the sidebar.
Assert outgoing arguments and selected event IDs through the real fixture service.
reject: Sort the single returned event client-side and claim policy parity.
Treat a matching function signature as proof.
fixtureTests: two callers preserve explicit and omitted config
lost forwarding negative control changes selection

cases.input: Data arrives before the community-events host registers. A second request supersedes it before registration. The card must show the current result once the real placement becomes available.
required: Separate data readiness, host readiness and request applicability.
Exercise delayed registration and controlled out-of-order completion.
Prevent disposed owners from rendering or emitting.
fixtureTests: late registry renders only the current result
disposed and superseded requests cannot render

cases.input: Saved event snapshots render correctly. A new incremental batch can rename an existing event and add another event. A reviewer calls saved-path support proof of stream parity.
required: Trace saved and incremental paths separately.
Reject duplicate/missing IDs and distinguish fixture batches from real transport streams.
reject: Claim streaming parity from a restore test.
Use current array positions as entity identity.
fixtureTests: stored and incremental paths share validated projection

cases.input: The events page shows the right event label, but the emitter might still use a stale event ID. The only existing assertion counts cards.
required: Assert the actual emitted fixture payload's current event and placement IDs.

Route a broader event-semantics investigation to analytics-event-debugging.

required: Identify the missing policy owner and decision.
Stop the policy-changing boundary rather than inventing eligibility behavior.
reject: Silently choose the more permissive API.
